name: Wind Fan

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Gust Of Wind
powers.text: Cast Gust of Wind (save DC 13). Each use after the first before dawn has a 20% chance to tear it.

summary: Cast Gust of Wind (save DC 13); each extra use in a day risks tearing it.
text: While holding this fan, you can cast Gust of Wind (save DC 13) from it. Each subsequent time the fan is used before the next dawn, it has a cumulative 20 percent chance of not working; if the fan fails to work, it tears into useless, nonmagical tatters.
